Switch branches

Source: R/dolt-branch.R
dolt_checkout.Rd

Each connection tracks its own active branch. Uncommitted work belongs to the *branch*, not the connection, so another connection that checks out the same branch sees the same working set. There is no stash: checking out does not shelve uncommitted changes.

Usage

dolt_checkout(con, name, create = FALSE)

Arguments

con

a `DoltliteConnection`.

name

the branch to check out.

create

create the branch first (`dolt_checkout('-b', name)`).

Value

Invisibly `TRUE`.
